## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon, 28 October 2026. The hosts went through a run of Nordic earnings reports: Equinor's strongest result since Q4 2022, SSAB and Electrolux Professional both beating EBITA estimates, Kone raising its guidance, and solid prints from Telenor, Norwegian, Acast and UBS. The main theme was the AI trade coming back. SK Hynix rose over 10% on a blowout report, the SOX semiconductor index gained 7% in a week, and new Anthropic deals with Broadcom (plus Oracle–Nvidia) lifted sentiment ahead of the Microsoft and Google reports and the Fed decision. No explicit buy or sell recommendations were given; the tone was mostly upbeat about the market.
